_doc: Routing eval corpus for scripts/eval_routing.py and
domovoi/tests/test_routing_corpus.py. Each case pins what the router
utterance  - what the user said (as Whisper would hand it over)
handler    - expected matched_handler; null means NO tool call, i.e.
tags       - subset selector for --only; 'qa' cases are the
note       - why the case exists (dated when it came from a live bug)
Keep 'qa' utterances timeless: weather/prices/scores go through the
volatile-question gate and would not come back as plain qa.
